starters.title: One-page business plan
starters.body: Draft a one-page business plan for [business idea] in [city/market]. Include the customer, offer, pricing, channels, costs, risks and the first three milestones.

starters.title: SWOT analysis
starters.body: Create a SWOT analysis for [company or product]. Be specific, and end with the two most important actions.

starters.title: Pricing strategy
starters.body: Suggest three pricing models for [product/service] aimed at [customer]. Compare them in a table with pros, cons and when to use each.

starters.title: Competitor snapshot
starters.body: Help me structure a competitor comparison for [market]. Give me the criteria to compare and a table template I can fill in.

starters.title: Board update outline
starters.body: Outline a concise board update covering results, key metrics, risks, decisions needed and next quarter's priorities for [company].

starters.title: Professional email
starters.body: Write a clear, warm and professional email to [recipient] about [topic]. Keep it under 150 words and end with a specific next step.

starters.title: Rewrite with confidence
starters.body:
Rewrite the following text so it sounds confident, concise and friendly, without changing its meaning:

[paste text]

starters.title: Executive summary
starters.body:
Turn these notes into a polished executive summary with a headline, three key points and a recommendation:

[paste notes]

starters.title: Proofread and explain
starters.body:
Proofread the text below. Show the corrected version, then list the most important changes and why:

[paste text]

starters.title: Launch announcement
starters.body: Write a launch announcement for [product] for [channel: LinkedIn/Instagram/email]. Give three variations with different hooks.

starters.title: Customer persona
starters.body: Create two customer personas for [product] in [market], including goals, frustrations, buying triggers and the message that would resonate.

starters.title: Campaign ideas
starters.body: Suggest five low-budget marketing campaign ideas for [business] to reach [audience] in the next 30 days, with expected effort and impact.

starters.title: Taglines
starters.body: Write ten short, premium-sounding taglines for [brand]. The brand values are [values].

starters.title: 90-day plan
starters.body: Create a 90-day plan to achieve [goal]. Break it into monthly themes, weekly actions and measurable milestones.

starters.title: Project plan
starters.body: Build a project plan for [project] with phases, tasks, owners, dependencies and risks, formatted as a table.

starters.title: Event checklist
starters.body: Make a detailed checklist for organising [event] for [number] people on [date], grouped by timeline.

starters.title: Decision matrix
starters.body: Help me decide between [option A] and [option B]. Build a weighted decision matrix and explain the result.

starters.title: Summarise a document
starters.body: Summarise the attached document in five bullet points, then list any deadlines, amounts or obligations it mentions.

starters.title: Key questions
starters.body: Read the attached document and list the ten most important questions someone should ask about it, with the answers where the document gives them.

starters.title: Draft a reply
starters.body: Based on the attached letter, draft a polite, firm reply that addresses each point it raises.

starters.title: Contract check
starters.body: Review the attached contract text and highlight clauses about payment, termination, liability and renewal. This is not legal advice.

starters.title: Topic overview
starters.body: Give me a structured overview of [topic]: key concepts, main players, current debates and what I should read next. Note anything that may be out of date.

starters.title: Compare approaches
starters.body: Compare [approach A], [approach B] and [approach C] for [goal] in a table covering cost, effort, risks and best use cases.

starters.title: Research plan
starters.body: Create a research plan to understand [question], including hypotheses, sources to check and how to verify the findings.

starters.title: Explain like I'm new
starters.body: Explain [complex topic] as if I'm new to it, then give an advanced summary for when I'm ready.

starters.title: Plan my week
starters.body: Help me plan my week. My priorities are [priorities], my fixed commitments are [commitments]. Suggest a realistic daily schedule.

starters.title: Build a habit
starters.body: Design a simple 30-day plan to build the habit of [habit], with a tiny daily action and a way to track progress.

starters.title: Inbox zero
starters.body: Give me a 20-minute daily routine to keep my email inbox under control, with rules for what to reply, delegate, schedule or archive.

starters.title: Learning plan
starters.body: Create a four-week learning plan for [skill] with 30 minutes a day, free resources and a small project to finish.
